# wcat — local knowledge for your AI agents

These wiki pages copy the [`docs/` folder](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/wirecat/tree/main/docs) on
every change to `main`, so an edit made here is overwritten. To fix a page, open a pull request against
`docs/`. Start with the [README](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/wirecat#readme).

Questions and ideas: [Discussions](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/wirecat/discussions). What changed in
each version: [releases](https://github.com/WireCatLabs/wirecat/releases). `wcat` is part of
[WireCat](https://wirecat.dev).
